mixed_arithmetic.basis: Both source tags explicitly assess precedence in multi-operation expressions.

fractions.basis: Rewriting equivalent fractions and finding a common denominator belong to this skill family. The source does not distinguish same-denominator items or isolate reduction.

decimals.basis: The original tag names both operations on positive decimal operands.

labels: Equation Solving Two or Fewer Steps
equations.basis: One- and two-step equation solving directly matches the intended scope.

area.basis: All six tags concern planar area. Volume and surface-area problems are outside this grouping.

word_modeling.basis: The source tag explicitly requires converting a situation to a linear equation. This covers a narrower family than all story problems.
